exercises.title: Testing the sign of a value
exercises.statement: D1 holds -10 (`$FFFFFFF6`, already loaded by the starting code). Test its sign with TST: if it is negative, put 1 in D0; otherwise, put 0 in D0.
hints: TST.L Dn sets the N and Z flags without changing Dn.

exercises.title: The greater of two numbers
exercises.statement: D1 = 21 and D2 = 30 (already loaded). Compare them with CMP and put the greater of the two values in D0 (signed comparison).
hints: CMP.L D1,D2 computes D2 - D1 and sets the flags, without changing D1 or D2.
BGT branches if the result of the comparison is strictly positive (signed comparison).

exercises.title: Testing a specific bit
exercises.statement: D3 = 5 (already loaded). Test bit 0 of D3 with BTST: if that bit is 1, put `$FF` in D0; otherwise, put `0`.
hints: BTST #n,Dn only updates the Z flag: Z=1 if the tested bit is 0, Z=0 if it is 1.
5 in binary is 101: bit 0 (the rightmost one) is 1.
